mapper.select: select o.order_id, o.order_date, c.category_name, p.product_id, p.product_name, p.hq_supply_price from orders o join order_item oi on oi.order_id=o.order_id join product p on p.product_id=oi.product_id join category c on c.category_id=p.category_id order by o.order_id desc
mapper.insert:
select seq_orders.nextval from dual
insert into orders values(#{order_id},#{store_id},#{order_date},#{total_supply_amount},#{commission_amount})
